0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The esurient Arkasodara is groaning weakly.

24.original: Deliver the leather coinpurse to Mehryde at Mehryde's Meyhane.

26.original: Carry the crate of apples to the designated location.

28.original: Give the leather coinpurse to Khufiye.

29.original: Hand over the egg-filled sack and the leather coinpurse to the esurient Arkasodara.

48.original: Y-You there... Please... T-Take my coinpurse to Mehryde's Meyhane... Buy all the apples you can... So...hungry...

49.original: I have no strength left... Auuugggh... My stomach... To Mehryde's Meyhane... Hurry...

50.original: Be still my growling stomach... Help is on the way...

51.original: Welcome to Mehryde's Meyhane! What can I─er...is something amiss?

52.original: Food for the hungry? Worry not─he has more than enough coin for a crateful of apples. Bring it to him with my blessing.

53.original: I'll take what I am owed and leave the rest. Pray return the remainder to him. You'll find the crate of apples in front of the meyhane.

54.original: I am unsure what has sapped your friend's strength so, but perhaps it would be best for you to bring him his apples with haste.

58.original: You successfully carried the crate to the designated location!

59.original: The crate crashes to the ground, sending the apples scattering. Sadly, they're unfit for eating now. Return to Mehryde's Meyhane to obtain a fresh batch.

60.original: Uuungh... My stomach burns with a thousand fires... Have you the apples?

61.original: The people of Radz-at-Han are so kind. So kind! Many thanks, friend.

62.original: You brought me so many apples, but... I'm afraid I'm still too weak to move. My body craves more... More...

63.original: If I could trouble you again... To bring me some hamsa eggs from Nilopala Nourishments... Take my coinpurse... I promise...I will make it up to you...

64.original: Urgh... I'm sorry, friend. I am still too weak to move...

65.original: ...The apples were not enough? But that crate could feed an entire family for days!

66.original: Welcome to Nilopala Nourishments. What can I do for you?

67.original: As many eggs as the coin in this purse can buy? Well, you're in luck. I have quite a surplus today. I shall give you the extras so they won't go to waste.

68.original: Here you go! ...And here's a share of your friend's coin back. It would seem he's greatly overestimated the cost of eggs these days.

69.original: It sounds like your friend is in dire straits. By all means, pray deliver his eggs before he collapses from hunger.

70.original: You're back! Did you...ungggh...find the eggs?

71.original: Ahhh... My favorite... The yolks just melt in your mouth. My stomach calms, and I feel my stamina return. Thank you so much, friend.

72.original: I had been attacked by a strange monster high up in the mountains. I descended as fast as I could, tumbling through brush and tree boughs.

73.original: Finally I returned home, but I was so exhausted. I collapsed, only to wake again to the pangs of my empty stomach. But I found I was too weak to get up!

74.original: Such is the curse of being so large. We Arkasodara have great strength at our disposal, but once that strength is spent, it requires a veritable feast to replenish.

75.original: You may have whatever coin is left in my purse as a token of my gratitude. You have done me a great service today.

84.original: Here you are. Your friend still has plenty of coin left over after your purchase. So I will just hand this back to you.
